sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity band under an assumed displayed-delta midpoint; not a validated confidence interval or conservative bound.

assumptions: Equal weekly entitlement across the calibrated observations.
Displayed integer quota percentages are used as an assumed midpoint signal.
Mapped exact-model token pricing is an API list-price-equivalent proxy.
limitations: UI percentages are integer and asynchronous; raw sub-percent values are absent.
Durable quota-to-token identity is absent, so the aggregate is calibration input rather than personal usage reporting.
External Codex CLI usage was not in the mapped numerator.
The estimate is not actual spend, official, exact, guaranteed, or provider-published.

privacy.scope: Product-level aggregate only; no personal observations are rendered.
